purpose: Admit a fact while adding a qualification.
keywords: Predicate + ことは + repeated predicate + が / けど
I did read it, but I do not remember it well.
It is cheap, but it looks likely to break quickly.
It is certainly quiet, but it is far from the station.
formation: Predicate + ことは + repeated predicate + が / けど
restrictions: Repeat the predicate, changing tense or politeness naturally where needed.
mistake: The admission is real; the following clause limits its usefulness or extent.
